flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats to win Senate control rose moderately, and Democrats remain the party the market favours. The Republican in [[Nebraska]], Pete Ricketts, saw a sharp rise in chances. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained ground, a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Florida]], where the Republican Byron Donalds saw a sharp drop in Polymarket odds. In [[Georgia]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained sizable ground. In [[Kansas]], also a predicted flip, the Republican Ty Masterson slipped by a sizable margin.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats favoured to win House control, with their chances edging up slightly. The biggest move came in [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], where the Republican, Dan Green, saw a sharp drop in chances, and the market treats it as a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott gained ground sharply, while in [[FL-14 (Plant City)]] the Democrat Kathy Castor made a sizable improvement.
